messages:
pagerbot: :rotating_light: Pager - suspicious auth token replay detected from edge-proxy.prod-eu. AlertID=PB-2026-60789. Pattern: repeated bearer tokens seen from multiple IPs within 30m, elevated 401->200 flip. Initial sig threshold crossed.
maria: saw the pager. @aj are you oncall? can you triage?
aj: oncall here, reading alert now. where is the bridge?
security: creating bridge -> https://meet.redwood/example-bridge (inc-PRIV-60789). Pulling logs and scope.
maria: high level: source=edge-proxy (eu), affected services=auth-service, session-cache, log-shipper. Suspect credential replay or service token exfil.
kevin: adding firewall block for the top offending /24s and throttling connections to auth-service. Pushing quick WAF rule.
lia: customers potentially impacted: AcmePayments, HealthOra (EU region). ETA notify in 30m if confirmed.
aj: running quick checks - log query: 
```
index=prod-logs source=edge-proxy status=200 OR status=401 | stats count by bearer_token, src_ip | sort - count desc | head 50
```
aj: seeing ~1200 events matching 3 tokens reused across 40 ips, mostly Germany IPs. tokens look like service-account scoped (client_id=svc-ingest).
security: good note - need to confirm if tokens are long-lived service tokens or user tokens. If svc tokens, rotate immediately.
neel: starting key rotation plan for svc-ingest: will generate new key, update dedicated cache, then roll through deployments with canary. Key rotation script: 
```
./ops/keyrotate.sh --service svc-ingest --env prod-eu --notify hooks
```
neel: estimating 12-15m for canary rollout, 30m for full rollout.
kevin: mitigating with rate-limiting at proxy level for bearer tokens seen in the alert and emergency denylist of IPs. Applying: 
```
kubectl -n infra patch configmap edge-proxy-ratelimit --patch '{"data":{"deny_tokens":"tokenA,tokenB,tokenC"}}'
```
maria: security, check if any logs were forwarded to external sinks. log-shipper shows some recent config changes; pause forwarding just in case.
security: pausing external log sinks for prod-eu now. Also snapshotting current logs for forensic: `s3://redwood-incidents/pb-60789/`
lia: customer comms draft: "We detected suspicious activity affecting authentication in EU region; we are mitigating and rotating implicated credentials. No confirmed data exfiltration of customer content at this time. We'll update in 60 minutes." Approve? :eyes:
aj: approve. send onholding.
maria: escalate to legal if any PII in logs - legal oncall is notified.
kevin: after throttle + denylist, auth-service error rate dropped to baseline. 5xxs unaffected. 401->200 flip reduced by 90%.
security: running token introspection: hitting introspect API for suspected tokens shows client_id=svc-ingest, scope=ingest:write, issued_by=internal-kms. No immediate user claims.
neel: proceeding with rotation. will update ops ticket INC-60789 in JIRA with steps and evidence.
lia: raising incident severity to P2 due to partial customer impact and credential compromise risk.
maria: next steps for handoff: @kevin you will own live mitigation for next 2h. @neel own key rotation completion. @security own forensic and log review. @lia own customer comms.
kevin: taking oncall handoff. checklist: 1) confirm denylist remains in place, 2) watch auth latencies, 3) confirm rollout of new svc key, 4) post update to status page.
kevin: status page update posted -> https://status.redwood.example/incidents/PRIV-60789 (short notice).
security: no external exfil detected in snapshots so far. pulling last 24h audit logs for KMS access and S3 GETs for pb-60789 prefix.
aj: running user-impact query - unique user sessions returning 401/200 flip ~ 0.03% of active EU sessions (roughly ~4k sessions total in 30m window). Likely small subset of customers.
lia: notifying impacted customers privately now (AcmePayments, HealthOra) with recommended rotation steps and our mitigation summary.
maria: creating incident summary doc -> https://docs.redwood.internal/incidents/PRIV-60789 (draft). Add timeline and remediation notes.
neel: rotation script completed canary, pushing full rollout now. monitoring for side-effects.
kevin: monitoring auth latencies and error budgets. No regression so far.
security: forensic note - initial suspicious token issuance occurred after a CI deploy to staging pipeline that had expanded log access. investigating whether staging creds were leaked.
maria: if staging CI write-access is implicated, pause staging pipelines and rotate pipeline service keys.
kevin: noted, pausing staging pipeline triggers. @aj can you take that?
aj: pausing staging triggers now.
lia: estimated next update in 30m or earlier on major changes.
maria: handing off - I'll step out in 15m. Kevin you have the bridge and incident ownership. Keep channel updated.
kevin: acknowledged, will coordinate with security and neel. filing handoff notes into INC-60789.
security: logging final action items for oncall: [rotate svc keys, pause staging pipeline, snapshot logs, notify customers, legal review]. Marking for follow-up postmortem.
maria: Thanks team. :thumbsup:
